messages.subject: Whitcombe v Sutherland Logistics - Schedule of Loss
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

Please find served herewith our client's Schedule of Loss in the above matter. As you will see, our client's losses are pleaded at £163,369, reflecting his age, length of service and the difficulty he has faced in finding comparable employment. We remain open to a constructive without prejudice discussion at the appropriate time.

We look forward to receiving your client's disclosure in due course.

Yours sincerely,
Eleanor Bartlett
Partner
Ashworth Quinn LLP
8 Temple Row, Birmingham B2 5HG
DDI 0121 246 7702
